name: World Cosplay Summit
blurb: An international cosplay championship with national teams from 40+ countries competing in Nagoya; the 2027 edition moves to a November date.

editions.evidence: Homepage text: 'World Cosplay Summit 2027 — November 12 (Fri) · 13 (Sat) · 14 (Sun), 2027 · Nagoya · SAVE THE DATE!' and '📅 DATE NOV 12–14, 2027 📍 LOCATION NAGOYA, JAPAN'

notes: WCS 2026 (Jul 31-Aug 2, 2026, Oasis 21 / Aichi Arts Center, Nagoya, 41 countries) already concluded before this research window. WCS 2027 was just announced (homepage countdown reads '403 days until WCS2027' as of this check) moving to a November date for the first time; no specific venue (beyond 'Nagoya') or competing countries/judges have been named yet, so venue is left blank and guests is 'none-yet' rather than guessed from the 2026 lineup. WCS is a national-team cosplay competition, not a celebrity-guest convention; past editions have had guest judges/performers (e.g. a 2026 photo of Shoko Nakagawa on stage) but none are confirmed for 2027.
